concept.title: Front seat adjustment for power seat

keywords.indexterm: seat front seat adjustment for power seat

conbody.p: You can adjust the driver’s seat by using the control switches located on the outside of the seat cushion. Before driving, adjust the seat to the proper position so you can easily control the steering wheel, pedals, and switches on the instrument panel.

note.p: Never leave children unattended in a vehicle. Children might operate features of the vehicle that could injure them.

li.p: The power seating controls function by motor. Repeated operation may cause damage to the electrical equipment.
Do not operate 2 or more power seat control switches at the same time. This may cause damage to the power seat motor or electrical components.

note.p: When in operation, the power seat consumes a large amount of electrical power. To prevent unnecessary charging system drain, do not adjust the power seat longer than necessary whilst the engine is not running.
